items.exampleEn: Football has displaced baseball as the most popular sport at our school.
items.exampleZh: 足球已經取代棒球，成為我們學校最受歡迎的運動。

items.exampleEn: Some parrots are excellent mimics of other birds.
items.exampleZh: 有些鸚鵡很會模仿其他鳥的叫聲。
items.glossZh: 模仿者；善於模仿的人或動物

items.exampleEn: She plucked a gray hair from her head.
items.exampleZh: 她從頭上拔下一根白頭髮。

items.exampleEn: The baby uttered her first word at ten months.
items.exampleZh: 那個寶寶十個月大時說出了第一個字。

items.exampleEn: Use this key to unlock the back door.
items.exampleZh: 用這把鑰匙打開後門的鎖。

items.exampleEn: The village finally paved the road to the school.
items.exampleZh: 村子終於把通往學校的路鋪好了。

items.exampleEn: The singer's speech aroused strong feelings in the crowd.
items.exampleZh: 那位歌手的演說在群眾中激起強烈的情緒。

items.exampleEn: Building the bridge in only six months was a great feat.
items.exampleZh: 只花六個月就蓋好那座橋，是一項了不起的成就。

items.sentenceEn: The strange noise aroused the curiosity of the neighbors.
items.sentenceZh: 那個奇怪的聲音引起了鄰居們的好奇。

items.audioEn: I forgot the code, so I couldn't unlock my bike and had to walk home.
items.audioZh: 我忘了密碼，沒辦法打開腳踏車的鎖，只好走路回家。

items.sentenceEn: Finishing the race with a broken shoe was quite a feat.
items.sentenceZh: 穿著一隻壞掉的鞋跑完比賽，真是了不起。

items.sentenceEn: The farmer plucked a ripe apple from the tree.
items.sentenceZh: 農夫從樹上摘下一顆成熟的蘋果。

items.stemEn: She was so shocked that she couldn't ____ a single word.
items.stemZh: 她驚訝到連一個字都說不出來。

items.stemEn: Her early films ____ the way for many young women directors.
items.stemZh: 她早期的電影為許多年輕女導演鋪了路。

items.passageEn: Last Saturday, a traveling show came to our town square. The first act was a mimic who could copy the voice of anyone in the crowd, from a crying baby to the mayor. Then a young woman performed an amazing feat: she climbed a tall pole without using her hands. Her calm face aroused everyone's interest. At the end, a magician plucked a coin from behind my ear, and for a moment I couldn't utter a word. It was a breathtaking show.
items.passageZh: 上週六，一個巡迴表演團來到我們鎮的廣場。第一個節目是一位模仿高手，他能模仿觀眾中任何人的聲音，從哭鬧的嬰兒到鎮長都學得維妙維肖。接著一位年輕女子表演了驚人的絕技：她不用手就爬上一根高高的柱子。她冷靜的表情引起了大家的興趣。最後，一位魔術師從我耳朵後面變出一枚硬幣，我一時之間說不出話來。那真是一場精彩萬分的表演。

questions.questionZh: 第一個節目的表演者會做什麼？
魔術師對作者做了什麼？

items.promptZh: 智慧型手機已經取代了許多舊式相機。
referenceEn: Phones have displaced many old cameras.
Many old cameras have been displaced by phones.
rubricZh: 要用 displace（例如 have displaced、have been displaced）
句型例如主動句、被動句等都可以
「智慧型手機」可寫，例如 smart phones、phones 等

items.instructionZh: 用 unlock 造一個句子，說說你平常怎麼開鎖或解鎖某樣東西。
referenceEn: I unlock my phone with a short code.
I unlock the front door with a key every evening.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 unlock（例如 unlock my phone、to unlock my bike）
時態配合內容（例如 unlock、forget 等）
